br_quiche_lorraine_potato_salad.title: Quiche Lorraine
br_quiche_lorraine_potato_salad.author: Nagi Maehashi
br_quiche_lorraine_potato_salad.notes: Same method (fry bacon/onion/garlic in butter, cheese then egg-and-cream custard into a blind-baked shortcrust case, bake 180°C fan until a slight wobble, rest 10 min). Scaled from a 23cm/8-serving quiche (4 eggs, 300ml cream, 200g bacon, 125g cheese) to a 20cm tin; mature cheddar instead of Gruyère (the source lists cheddar as an option); ready-rolled shortcrust (also a source option). Mustard potato salad side is our addition.

br_pork_apple_burgers.title: Pork and apple burgers
br_pork_apple_burgers.author: Tesco Real Food team
br_pork_apple_burgers.notes: Same patty (pork mince, grated apple, grated carrot, breadcrumbs, Worcestershire, egg), grilled on medium with cheese melted on top. Panko for breadcrumbs; mince scaled to 400g for 2 bigger patties so grill time raised to 7–8 min a side; apple and red cabbage slaw and mustard mayo replace tomato, iceberg and burger sauce.

am_bbq_ribs_wedges.title: Oven Pork Ribs with Barbecue Sauce
am_bbq_ribs_wedges.author: Nagi Maehashi
am_bbq_ribs_wedges.notes: Same method: paprika/herb dry rub, low oven covered tightly in foil with liquid underneath for about 1 hr 30 min, uncover to crust, then repeated brush-and-roast glazing bony side then meaty side. Shop-bought BBQ sauce pepped up with honey, Worcestershire and garlic replaces the 45-min homemade sauce; water replaces cider; scaled from 2–2.5kg to 700g. Wedges and slaw added.

am_loaded_potato_skins.title: Loaded Baked Potato Skins
am_loaded_potato_skins.author: Katie Workman
am_loaded_potato_skins.notes: Same build: cooked baking potatoes halved and scooped to a thin shell, brushed with oil, seasoned and baked hot until crisp, filled with crispy bacon and cheese, baked until melted, topped with soured cream and onion. Microwave pre-cook replaces the 1-hr oven bake; all cheddar instead of cheddar + Monterey Jack; spring onions for chives; scaled from 6 to 3 potatoes; side salad added.

am_tuna_melts.title: Tuna melt
am_tuna_melts.notes: Same dish: tuna mayo with red onion and chilli on buttered toasted bread, topped with grated cheddar and grilled until golden. Jalapeños (optional) for fresh red chilli, sweetcorn instead of celery, toast under the grill instead of a griddle pan, much less mayo than the source's 1 cup; scaled from 4 to 2.

am_spicy_bean_burgers.title: Spicy Bean Burgers
am_spicy_bean_burgers.notes: Same patty: roughly mashed kidney beans bound with breadcrumbs and egg, spiced with chilli powder and paprika, cooked 4–5 min a side, served in buns with cheese and yogurt. One tin instead of two; pan-fried instead of grilled; garlic, spring onion and cumin added; coriander moved to an optional smashed-avocado topping; branded relish dropped; sweet potato wedges added. (Also cross-checked against Tesco's egg-topped veggie bean burgers: https://www.tesco.com/recipes/en-GB/recipe/egg-topped-veggie-bean-burgers, same 4–5 min-a-side pan-fry.)

as_prawn_noodle_stir_fry.title: One-pot prawn and noodle stir-fry
as_prawn_noodle_stir_fry.notes: Same core (king prawns and pak choi stir-fried over high heat, tossed with egg noodles in a soy and chilli sauce), same quantities per 2 (165g prawns, 250g pak choi). Dried egg noodle nests instead of ready-cooked; red pepper, garlic, ginger and spring onion added; oyster + sweet chilli + light soy replace dark soy and Sriracha (Sriracha kept as optional).

as_singapore_noodles.title: Singapore Noodles
as_singapore_noodles.author: Nagi Maehashi
as_singapore_noodles.notes: Same recipe for 2: soaked rice noodles, prawns cooked first, thin rolled omelette, onion/garlic/ginger then red pepper, tossed with a soy + 2½ tsp curry powder + sugar + pepper sauce, char siu and optional green chilli. Catalogue flat rice noodles instead of thin vermicelli; hoisin-glazed pork loin steak instead of bought char siu (the source gives a quick pan-fried version); water for Shaoxing wine; honey for sugar; black for white pepper; optional beansprouts added.

as_chinese_lemon_chicken.title: Crispy Chinese Lemon Chicken
as_chinese_lemon_chicken.author: Nagi Maehashi
as_chinese_lemon_chicken.notes: Same method: thin chicken steaks salted and dusted in cornflour, dipped in a cornflour/flour batter made with ice-cold water, double-fried (160°C for 3 min, rest, then 190–200°C for 2–3 min), served sliced with a cornflour-thickened lemon, stock, sugar, garlic and ginger sauce over rice. Chicken breast halved horizontally (source allows); self-raising flour in place of plain flour + baking powder; ice-cold tap water for soda water; honey for sugar; scaled to about two-thirds; broccoli added.
